items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: Tony Johnson, Tony Ginsanti, he went with Horace Hite, and then with Frankie Carle...

ctx.x: Rocky Carruccio, Rocky Cole, piano, Charlie French, Art French. Well there were a lot of good musicians out of this area. Tony Johnson, Tony Ginsanti, he went with Horace Hite, and then with Frankie Carle, when Frankie Carle left Horace Heidt, he went with him. And Rocky Carruccio or Rocky Cole was the piano player, went with Patti Page, he stayed with her for years.
Well great. We’re going to wrap up here, and let our cameraman go home.
